sourceOfTruth.rule: Production components and canonical tokens own visual truth. Mockups and screenshots are reference evidence only.

typography.fontDisplay: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif
typography.fontMono: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace

spacing.semanticRule: Use proximity before adding cards or borders. Preserve larger section spacing for narrative phases and tighter spacing inside one decision group.

rules: Scroll-coupled motion must preserve direct user control and reverse naturally when scrolling backwards.
Repeated UI interactions use fast or base motion; slow motion is reserved for large narrative transitions.
Autoplaying decorative or product-preview carousels are avoided unless explicit pause/stop control is provided.
Reduced motion removes scroll-coupled transforms and preserves all content and hierarchy.

imagery.rule: Graphics explain or prove. Decorative imagery must never be required to understand the product or be mistaken for measured evidence.

iconography.style: simple outline or minimal system icons
iconography.rule: Icons support labels and state; they do not replace essential text unless the control has an accessible name.
